sites.site: Land at 28 Godstone Road, Kenley, CR8 5JE

currentPlanningIdentity.proposal: Erection of three terraced dwellings with associated landscaping, cycle/refuse storage and communal garden.

publicEvidence.source: Planning Atlas capture of Croydon application 25/03774/FUL
observed: Exact site/application identity and UPRN 10095497120 are linked.
Twenty-nine planning documents are linked to the council file.
Indexed documents include the decision notice, final officer report, BNG metric, application form, location plan, flood-risk assessment, biodiversity survey and additional documents.
The captured register records refusal on 23 January 2026.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: Useful document-transport and exact-identity evidence derived from a capture of the council register; decision outcome and applicant proposal do not prove Reference House acceptability.

observed: Site is materially steep/sloping and was admitted specifically as a topography stress case.
Measured contours, gradients and usable level datum were not frozen by DPL-14.
Application proposal contains three dwellings and cannot be transferred into a one-house Reference House candidate.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: Corpus authority for the admitted stress condition and unknowns; not measured survey geometry.

observed: Environment Agency LiDAR Composite DTM 1 m has already been accepted by DPL as SCREENING datum/topography authority when exact site identity and CRS are controlled.
The DTM remains explicitly below private measured topographic survey authority.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: Proves an admissible SCREENING source class, not that RP-007 terrain bytes have already been acquired.

observed: The first-party weekly decision publication places 25/03774/FUL under a Permission Granted heading with decision date 23 January 2026.
This conflicts with the captured register and other public surfaces that label the same application refused.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: The conflicting decision label is retained as a provenance conflict and is not consumed by candidate-readiness selection. Direct decision-notice inspection is required before any planning-outcome use.

sites.site: Land at rear of 32 Gleneldon Road / Ashlake Road, Streatham, SW16 2BD

currentPlanningIdentity.proposal: Demolition of three existing garages and erection of one one-bedroom dwelling.

observed: Exact application reference 24/00124/FUL and site identity are published by Lambeth.
The proposal is one dwelling on the garage site, making the planning parcel conceptually aligned with a one-house deployment experiment.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: First-party application identity/proposal evidence only; the weekly list does not provide placement-ready geometry.

observed: Site is the corpus lower-pathology small-plot control.
Current marketing reports approximately 97 square metres, but DPL classifies this only as approximate marketing measurement.
Exact legal/title/red-line extent, surveyed dimensions, orientation and levels remain unknown.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: Approximate 97 square metre marketing area cannot establish fit, no-fit or controlled geometry.

observed: Lambeth provides online planning application records and documents for modern applications.
The current bounded search has not yet recovered the exact RP-008 site-plan/drawing bytes or an indexed document stack comparable to RP-007.
publicEvidence.authorityBoundary: A generic authority-hosted document route is not evidence that the decision-critical RP-008 geometry bytes are retrievable.

selection.reason: RP-007 currently has the stronger demonstrated evidence transport: exact application identity and UPRN plus a 29-document council-linked stack containing the classes needed to pursue geometry, orientation and terrain. Its steep topography is a deliberate corpus stress condition, not a reason to reject the site, and DPL already has an admissible EA DTM route for SCREENING datum evidence. The three-dwelling applicant scheme is not transferred; the next packet must prove that the full controlled parcel can support one independently authored Reference House experiment without parcel redefinition. RP-008 remains the cleaner one-house control but its decision-critical geometry document route is not yet demonstrated strongly enough to displace RP-007. The conflicting public planning-decision labels for RP-007 are explicitly irrelevant to this selection.

nextPacket: DPL-15H — RP-007 bounded spatial-evidence acquisition and R1-R6 re-run
